description: Phase 3 of the 1ppb workplan: atom binding at H_{3A} via the canonical hecke_core._canon chain (convention B, E_0 = Q_β^CODATA). NO FITTING per owner directive 2026-05-10. The residuals vs AME 2020 are the honest exposure of the brane-tower closure problem — the ℏ_q² scaling is structurally correct (via |tr_M| difference); the gap is in the T2/T3 brane-tower terms, not in E_0.

convention_metadata.scaling: ℏ_q^0 (|Δ(net)| = 1 implicit; ℏ_q^2 absorbed into the calibration)
convention_metadata.hecke_level: H_{3A} (atom-level: H_6 D, H_9 T/³He, H_12 ⁴He)
convention_metadata.derivation: Calibration to CAL-3 Q_β(n) directly. Sets the operator Δ_NF ≡ 1 in cat-units; canonical for `hecke_core._canon` style chains where the operator difference |tr_M(W_free)| - |tr_M(W_atom)| is dimensionless and carries its own ℏ_q powers.
convention_metadata.operator_class: Atom-level binding B(Z, N) = E_0 · (|tr_M(W_free)| - |tr_M(W_atom)|) at H_{3A}. The trace-difference operator carries the ℏ_q^2 scaling; E_0 is the unit-action scale.
convention_metadata.validity: Phase 3+ Triton / ³He / ⁴He binding MUST use this convention. Naively using convention A with a Δ(net)-style operator difference would miss the 1/ℏ_q^2 factor (≈ 102× error).
